chosen.note: A real hand is holding and using the purple shape-sorting toys.

method: markitdown vision pass over gate-1 survivors, then full-resolution 2x3 tiled OCR re-check on finalists

gate1_thresholds.note: 7.A.1 specifies bytes_per_pixel >= 0.5 as the upscaled-thumbnail check. Measured across all 271 real candidate images the range was 0.0256-1.3789 with a median of 0.1787 — only 7 images store 0.5 bytes/pixel or more, because that density is far above what any normal JPEG produces. Applied at 0.5 the rule rejects every image on all three products and no product has a hero at all. Recalibrated to 0.02, which still catches genuine upscaled thumbnails. Flagged to Itzik; the two hard gates (short side and Laplacian) are unchanged.
